parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the server group that you want to delete.
To delete a server group, you must specify the server group ID. You can call the [DescribeAllGroups](~~DescribeAllGroups~~) operation to obtain the server group ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要删除的服务器分组ID。
删除服务器分组，需要提供服务器分组ID，该ID可调用[DescribeAllGroups](~~DescribeAllGroups~~)接口获取
parameters.name: group_id

Code.description_en: The result code. A value of 200 indicates success. Other values indicate failure. You can use this field to determine the cause of the failure
Code.description_zh: 结果代码，200表示成功，若为别的值则表示失败，调用方可根据此字段判断失败原因

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique ID for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
